facts.fact: Togo Officiel says the DGDN, the business formalities centre (CFE) and the commercial register (RCCM) are now connected so users can do several procedures through one channel, notably company creation.
Togo Officiel says a database of companies' beneficial owners has been created to identify who really owns a company.

Togo Officiel says citizens can complete all cadastre procedures for a land title remotely through an online portal, and ARCEP launched an e-services platform for declarations, approvals and equipment certification.
facts.system: Online land title portal; ARCEP e-services platform

facts.fact: Togo Officiel says the process of obtaining land titles is fully dematerialised through an online portal handling all cadastre procedures.
Togo Officiel says land title procedures are fully dematerialised, with all cadastre procedures done remotely via an online portal.
Togo Officiel says citizens can now carry out all cadastre procedures for a land title remotely through an online portal.
